definitions.explanation: Food given to farm animals and livestock, including both natural and processed feed.

examples.japanese: {家畜|かちく}に{飼料|しりょう}を{与|あた}える。
{飼料|しりょう}の{価格|かかく}が{上|あ}がっている。
{輸入|ゆにゅう}{飼料|しりょう}への{依存|いぞん}を{減|へ}らすため、{国産|こくさん}{飼料|しりょう}の{生産|せいさん}を{増|ふ}やす{取|と}り{組|く}みが{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Efforts are underway to increase domestic feed production in order to reduce dependence on imported feed.

notes:
A compound of {飼|し} (to raise animals, to feed) and {料|りょう} (material, ingredient). The standard formal term for animal feed used in agriculture, news, and economics.

USAGE:
A homophone of {資料|しりょう} (materials, documents) — context usually makes the meaning clear. {飼料|しりょう} appears frequently in news about agriculture, food prices, and trade, since Japan imports much of its livestock feed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配合|はいごう}{飼料|しりょう} — compound/mixed feed
- {飼料|しりょう}{米|まい} — feed rice (rice grown for animal feed)
- {飼料|しりょう}{用|よう} — for feed use
- {飼料|しりょう}{価格|かかく} — feed prices

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {餌|えさ} — food for animals; general term, also used for pets and bait
- {肥料|ひりょう} — fertilizer; for plants, not animals
- {資料|しりょう} — materials, documents; homophone with different meaning
